title: EngagementArchived.v1
description: Optional hook (declared assumption about the owning team): an engagement was archived; ms-engagement-index writes an ARCHIVED tombstone with TTL_tomb so late events do not resurrect it.
$comment: Source: DISENO 4.3 catalog EV-12; RF-010 (scope 'active'), RF-083. Producer: engagements-system. Consumers: ms-engagement-index. Channel: engagements-system outbox -> cell EventBridge bus -> rule -> SQS {cell}-ms-engagement-index-engagements-system. Ordering/partition key: engagementId + engagementSeq. Idempotency key: eventId. Guarantee: at-least-once. Versioning: contract with the owning team (ADR-015); optional event (if the Engagement System does not emit it, reconciliation detects archived engagements); engagementSeq is optional in v1 (DEC-37). dataClass: ENGAGEMENT_REGIONAL (DISENO 4.3). Stays inside the firm's cell; may carry engagement, firm or user identifiers but never workpaper content.
x-channel: engagements-system outbox -> cell EventBridge bus -> rule -> SQS {cell}-ms-engagement-index-engagements-system

engagementSeq.description: engagementSeq: monotonic per-engagement sequence emitted by the Engagement System hook (DEC-15). Declared assumption (ADR-021, SUP-21): optional because the legacy system may not provide it; if absent, ordering falls back to (occurredAt, eventId) and reconciliation (DISENO 4.6).
